_comment: SFX1 (Директор 01.11, 21:59, стр. 22): звук первого открытия боковой двери — «типа щеколды или засова, дай несколько на выбор». 6 вариантов ElevenLabs (text-to-sound-effects), на страницу выбора; в игру — по выбору (sfx.json / H3 on_pass)

items.text: Heavy old iron door bolt slid open with a rusty scrape, then an old wooden cottage door creaks open slowly, quiet interior, no music
Stiff old iron sliding bolt on a wooden door pulled back in two short jerks, ending with a metallic clack, quiet room, no music
Wooden thumb latch of an old village cottage door lifted with a click and a dry wooden rattle, quiet room, no music
Rusty iron hook-and-eye door latch unhooked with a small metallic tick, then old door hinges creak briefly, quiet room, no music
Heavy wooden crossbar lifted out of iron brackets on an old door, wood scraping on iron, a dull wooden thunk as it is set down, no music
Old iron door bolt drawn back once, a single clean metallic clack, small quiet room, no music
